cases.name: six-keys-five-edits
cases.notes: The size evidence behind 16.0 (§10 Decisions), reproduced from the per-key-parts branch 2f7b286: one document with six frontmatter keys, then five revisions each changing one key. Through 15.x every revision added a whole frontmatter blob (~100 B); here every revision after the first (a checkpoint) adds one `{"f":…}` delta blob of 11–30 B of changed line plus ~20 B of ops, and the body root is reused (self-contained, unchanged).

cases.name: journal-forty-blocks-five-appends
cases.notes: §4.1 body deltas: a 40-block document (two headings, 37 paragraphs, a list) whose last list gains one item per revision — the journal-logline shape. Through 15.x every append rewrote the whole root node (~170 B × 40 entries) and the list's child node; here the root is `{"d":[["=",39],["~",<the list entry>]]}` and the list's children `{"d":[["=",n],["+",<the new item>]]}`.

cases.name: checkpoint-every-sixteen
cases.notes: §4.4 the cadence: a ten-paragraph document and twenty one-paragraph edits. Revisions 2–16 and 18–21 are `{"d":…}` roots over their predecessor; revision 17 (`(17 − 1) % 16 == 0`) is a full, self-contained root, so a reader resolving revision 21 walks back at most to it. The projection shows the one full root per sixteen revisions and the per-revision delta otherwise.

cases.name: squash-rechecks-the-dependent
cases.notes: §4.4 base liveness, §7.1 (16.0): six revisions on six days, each a delta over the previous (root and frontmatter). The export at day 10 under `keep_days 0, per_doc_max 2, ladder [{ after_days 0, one per year }]` archives revisions 1–4 (one 2026 bucket whose representative, revision 6, is kept anyway) and keeps 5–6; revision 5's base (4) leaves, so the squash re-writes revision 5 in checkpoint form (`squashed.checkpointed: 1`: a full root, a raw frontmatter) before the bases lose their bodies, revision 6 stays a delta over 5, and the segment holds revisions 1–4 as full nodes and raw frontmatter. Every revision reconstructs afterwards — the archived through the segment, the live by resolution — and a seventh revision is a delta over 6; gc finds nothing.
